data.name: War of the Damned
data.detailed_description:
War of the Damned is a dark fantasy RPG set in the twilight of a humanity that once ruled the stars. After a brutal war that nearly brought about human extinction, the survivors remain isolated and fractured. In this landscape of ruin, various factions clash, each claiming to be the true heir of an empire that no longer exists. The game plunges players into this eternal war of remnants, where factions devour one another for control and survival.

Features and System:

  • d100 Automation: The game engine fully processes the d100 rule system, managing successes, damage, and modifiers instantly to speed up the session's pace.

  • Turn-Based Combat: Encounters are resolved in turns, where each miniature uses its action and movement points to attack and position itself.

  • Equipment Wear: Weapons and tools wear out with use, requiring constant equipment management to avoid failures at critical moments.

  • Bestiary and Customization: Includes 24 types of enemies with their own stats and abilities, along with tools for the Game Master to create their own custom threats by uploading their own images or 3D models for miniatures (up to 50MB per file). Advanced customization features and additional Workshop slots are available with the GM Pack.

  • Campaign Management: Create and direct your stories by dividing them into scenes and using your own maps. Managing more than one active campaign as a Game Master requires the GM Pack.

data.short_description: War of the Damned is a tabletop RPG designed for Game Masters and players to bring their own adventures to life in a world in ruins. An intuitive and friendly experience, ideal for those looking to dive into the action without barriers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 | AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
